        self.assertEqual(migration_contract_issues(self.MIGRATION), [])
        injected = self.MIGRATION + "\nADISCORD_live = { ADISCORD_economy_construction_spending_mode = yes }"
        self.assertTrue(migration_contract_issues(injected))

    def test_capacity_boundary_covers_omitted_common_surfaces_and_mixed_migration_operations(self):
        for path in (
            "common/ai_strategy/injected.txt",
            "common/dynamic_modifiers/injected.txt",
        ):
            self.assertTrue(retired_capacity_boundary_issues({path: "replacement_debt_capacity = yes"}), path)
        mixed = """
ADISCORD_economy_migrate_schema = {
 clear_variable = ADISCORD_economy_debt_capacity
 set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_debt_capacity value = 10 }
}
"""
        self.assertTrue(retired_capacity_boundary_issues({
            "common/scripted_effects/ADISCORD_economy_effects.txt": mixed
        }))

    def test_creditworthiness_modifier_migration_has_no_duplicate_block_keys(self):
        paths = (
            ROOT / "common" / "ideas" / "_economic.txt",
            ROOT / "common" / "ideas" / "ADISCORD_laws.txt",
            ROOT / "common" / "ideas" / "ADISCORD_VAL_rework_ideas.txt",
        )
        for path in paths:
            text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
            self.assertFalse(
                duplicate_direct_key_blocks(
                    text, "ADISCORD_economy_creditworthiness_factor"
                ),
                path.name,
            )

        economic = paths[0].read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
        migrated_line = "ADISCORD_economy_creditworthiness_factor = -0.10"
        duplicate = economic.replace(
            migrated_line,
            migrated_line + "\n\t\t\t" + migrated_line,
            1,
        )
        self.assertNotEqual(duplicate, economic)
        self.assertTrue(
            duplicate_direct_key_blocks(
                duplicate, "ADISCORD_economy_creditworthiness_factor"
            )
        )

    def test_validator_accepts_full_deficit_ledger_without_obsolete_unfunded_state(self):
        self.assertEqual(automatic_borrow_flow_issues(EFFECTS), [])
        issues = validate_economy_ai()
        for obsolete in (
            "unfunded deficit is not recorded in the weekly ledger",
            "treasury-floor adjustment is missing from the accounting identity",
            "unfunded-deficit pressure ignores its custom modifier",
        ):
            self.assertNotIn(obsolete, issues)

    def test_debt_metric_fixture_rejects_formula_floor_order_and_principal_mutations(self):
        self.assertEqual(debt_metric_flow_issues(self.DEBT_METRICS), [])
        mutations = {
            "reversed annual-income floor": self.DEBT_METRICS.replace(
                "value = 1 compare = less_than",
                "value = 1 compare = greater_than",
                1,
            ),
            "missing weekly-income floor": self.DEBT_METRICS.replace(
                "  set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_interest_income_denominator_temp value = 0.1 }\n",
                "",
                1,
            ),
            "dead weekly-income floor": self.DEBT_METRICS.replace(
                "limit = { check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_interest_income_denominator_temp value = 0.1 compare = less_than } }",
                "limit = { check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_interest_income_denominator_temp value = 0.1 compare = less_than } always = no }",
                1,
            ),
            "reordered ratio arithmetic": self.DEBT_METRICS.replace(
                " multiply_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_debt_income_ratio value = 100 }\n divide_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_debt_income_ratio value = ADISCORD_economy_debt_income_denominator_temp }",
                " divide_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_debt_income_ratio value = ADISCORD_economy_debt_income_denominator_temp }\n multiply_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_debt_income_ratio value = 100 }",
                1,
            ),
            "pressure coefficient changed": self.DEBT_METRICS.replace(
                "ADISCORD_economy_interest_pressure_temp value = 1.50",
                "ADISCORD_economy_interest_pressure_temp value = 1.25",
                1,
            ),
            "duplicate weekly-interest calculation": self.DEBT_METRICS.replace(
                " multiply_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_weekly_interest value = 3 }",
                " multiply_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_weekly_interest value = 3 }\n multiply_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_weekly_interest value = 3 }",
                1,
            ),
            "stored principal clamp": self.DEBT_METRICS.replace(
                " ADISCORD_economy_update_debt_crisis_level = yes",
                " clamp_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_debt min = 0 max = 5000 }\n ADISCORD_economy_update_debt_crisis_level = yes",
                1,
            ),
        }
        for name, mutation in mutations.items():
            with self.subTest(mutation=name):
                self.assertNotEqual(mutation, self.DEBT_METRICS)
                self.assertTrue(debt_metric_flow_issues(mutation))

        for variable, threshold in (
            ("ADISCORD_economy_debt_income_denominator_temp", "1"),
            ("ADISCORD_economy_interest_income_denominator_temp", "0.1"),
        ):
            exact_limit = (
                "limit = { check_variable = { var = "
                f"{variable} value = {threshold} compare = less_than }} }}"
            )
            for mutation_name, extra_predicate in (
                ("extra scalar predicate", "has_country_flag = hidden_floor_gate "),
                (
                    "extra compound predicate",
                    "AND = { has_country_flag = hidden_floor_gate } ",
                ),
            ):
                mutation = self.DEBT_METRICS.replace(
                    exact_limit,
                    exact_limit.replace(
                        "limit = { ", f"limit = {{ {extra_predicate}", 1
                    ),
                    1,
                )
                with self.subTest(
                    floor=variable,
                    mutation=mutation_name,
                ):
                    self.assertNotEqual(mutation, self.DEBT_METRICS)
                    self.assertTrue(debt_metric_flow_issues(mutation))

    def test_structural_call_graph_handles_parameter_blocks_decoys_duplicates_and_cycles(self):
        graph = """
ADISCORD_root = { ADISCORD_scalar = yes # ADISCORD_comment = yes
                 ADISCORD_parameter = { ARG = value } decoy = "ADISCORD_quote = yes" }
ADISCORD_scalar = { ADISCORD_root = yes }
ADISCORD_parameter = { ADISCORD_heavy = { OTHER = value } }
ADISCORD_heavy = { has_idea = forbidden }
"""
        reachable = reachable_script_entries((graph,), ("ADISCORD_root",))
        self.assertEqual(set(reachable), {
            "ADISCORD_root", "ADISCORD_scalar", "ADISCORD_parameter", "ADISCORD_heavy"
        })
        self.assertNotIn("ADISCORD_comment", reachable)
        self.assertNotIn("ADISCORD_quote", reachable)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(AssertionError, "duplicate"):
            reachable_script_entries((graph + "\nADISCORD_heavy = { always = yes }",), ("ADISCORD_root",))

    def test_weekly_heavy_analyzer_rejects_all_edge_shapes_without_decoy_noise(self):
        clean = """
ADISCORD_root = {
  ADISCORD_safe = yes
  quoted_decoy = "has_idea"
  quoted_call_decoy = "ADISCORD_heavy = yes"
  # has_idea = forbidden
}
ADISCORD_safe = { check_variable = { var = cached_value value = 1 compare = equals } }
ADISCORD_heavy = { has_idea = forbidden }
ADISCORD_cycle = { ADISCORD_root = yes }
"""
        self.assertEqual(weekly_reachability_issues((clean,), ("ADISCORD_root",)), [])
        mutations = {
            "scalar heavy edge": clean.replace(
                "ADISCORD_safe = yes", "ADISCORD_safe = yes ADISCORD_heavy = yes", 1
            ),
            "parameter heavy edge": clean.replace(
                "ADISCORD_safe = yes",
                "ADISCORD_safe = yes ADISCORD_heavy = { ARG = value }",
                1,
            ),
            "cycle-hidden heavy edge": clean.replace(
                "ADISCORD_safe = {",
                "ADISCORD_safe = { ADISCORD_cycle = yes ADISCORD_heavy = yes",
                1,
            ),
        }
        for name, mutation in mutations.items():
            with self.subTest(mutation=name):
                self.assertTrue(
                    weekly_reachability_issues((mutation,), ("ADISCORD_root",)),
                    name,
                )
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(AssertionError, "duplicate"):
            weekly_reachability_issues(
                (clean + "\nADISCORD_heavy = { always = yes }",),
                ("ADISCORD_root",),
            )

8281 FreshEconomyInitializationTests
class FreshEconomyInitializationTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def _issues(
        self,
        effects=EFFECTS,
        triggers=TRIGGERS,
        general_history=GENERAL_HISTORY,
        shared_on_actions=ON_ACTIONS,
        war_on_actions=WAR_ON_ACTIONS,
        runtime_sources=None,
    ):
        return fresh_economy_initialization_issues(
            effects,
            triggers,
            general_history,
            shared_on_actions,
            war_on_actions,
            runtime_sources or {"common/scripted_effects/economy.txt": effects},
        )

    def test_fresh_only_initializer_and_current_schema_routes_are_valid(self):
        self.assertEqual(self._issues(), [])

    def test_initializer_rejects_missing_provenance_or_live_migration(self):
        missing_fresh = EFFECTS.replace(
            "\t\thas_global_flag = ADISCORD_fresh_campaign_contract_v1\n",
            "",
            1,
        )
        self.assertTrue(self._issues(effects=missing_fresh))

        live_migration = EFFECTS.replace(
            "\t\tADISCORD_economy_set_simulation_tier = yes\n\t}\n}\n",
            "\t\tADISCORD_economy_migrate_schema = yes\n"
            "\t\tADISCORD_economy_set_simulation_tier = yes\n\t}\n}\n",
            1,
        )
        issues = self._issues(
            effects=live_migration,
            runtime_sources={"common/scripted_effects/economy.txt": live_migration},
        )
        self.assertTrue(any("migration" in issue for issue in issues), issues)

    def test_scheduled_gate_and_external_migration_caller_are_rejected(self):
        widened = TRIGGERS.replace(
            "ADISCORD_economy_should_monthly_update = {\n"
            "\tADISCORD_economy_has_current_schema = yes\n",
            "ADISCORD_economy_should_monthly_update = {\n",
            1,
        )
        self.assertTrue(self._issues(triggers=widened))
        issues = self._issues(
            runtime_sources={
                "common/scripted_effects/economy.txt": EFFECTS,
                "events/legacy.txt": "ADISCORD_economy_migrate_schema = yes\n",
            }
        )
        self.assertTrue(any("runtime-callable" in issue for issue in issues), issues)
8340 DormantMinorLifecycleTests
class DormantMinorLifecycleTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.triggers = (ROOT / "common/scripted_triggers/ADISCORD_minor_optimization_triggers.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        self.effects = (ROOT / "common/scripted_effects/ADISCORD_minor_optimization_effects.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        self.hooks = (ROOT / "common/on_actions/00_ADISCORD_minor_optimization_on_actions.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        self.shared = (ROOT / "common/on_actions/00_ADISCORD_on_actions.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        self.definitions = {entry.key: entry.value for entry in parse_clausewitz(self.triggers + self.effects)}

    def state(self, tag="AUR", ai=True, war=False, optimized=True):
        return {"tag": tag, "is_ai": ai, "has_war": war, "flags": {
            "ADISCORD_non_participating_minor_optimized": optimized,
            "ADISCORD_minor_optimization_fresh_campaign_v1": True,
        }, "slots": 0, "locked": optimized, "idea": optimized, "initializations": 0}

    def condition(self, entries, state):
        def value(entry):
            if entry.key == "OR":
                return any(value(child) for child in entry.value)
            if entry.key == "NOT":
                return not self.condition(entry.value, state)
            if entry.key in {"has_country_flag", "has_global_flag"}:
                return state["flags"].get(entry.value, False)
            if entry.key == "tag":
                return state["tag"] == entry.value
            if entry.key in {"is_ai", "has_war"}:
                return state[entry.key] == (entry.value == "yes")
            if entry.key in self.definitions:
                return self.condition(self.definitions[entry.key], state) == (entry.value == "yes")
            self.fail(f"unsupported condition in static lifecycle fixture: {entry.key}")
        return all(value(entry) for entry in entries)

    def execute(self, entries, state):
        matched = False
        for entry in entries:
            if entry.key in {"if", "else_if"}:
                if entry.key == "if":
                    matched = False
                limit = next(child.value for child in entry.value if child.key == "limit")
                if not matched and self.condition(limit, state):
                    self.execute([child for child in entry.value if child.key != "limit"], state)
                    matched = True
            elif entry.key in {"set_country_flag", "clr_country_flag"}:
                state["flags"][entry.value] = entry.key == "set_country_flag"
            elif entry.key == "set_research_slots":
                state["slots"] = int(entry.value)
            elif entry.key == "country_lock_all_division_template":
                state["locked"] = entry.value == "yes"
            elif entry.key in {"add_ideas", "remove_ideas"}:
                state["idea"] = entry.key == "add_ideas"
            elif entry.key == "ADISCORD_economy_initialize_country":
                state["initializations"] += 1
            elif entry.key in self.definitions and entry.value == "yes":
                self.execute(self.definitions[entry.key], state)
            else:
                self.fail(f"unsupported effect in static lifecycle fixture: {entry.key}")

    def test_release_paths_preserve_dormant_ai_and_are_idempotent(self):
        cases = (
            (self.state(), False, 0),
            (self.state(ai=False), True, 1),
            (self.state(war=True), True, 0),
            (self.state(tag="AIN"), True, 0),
            (self.state(ai=False, optimized=False), False, 0),
        )
        reconcile = self.definitions["ADISCORD_reconcile_non_participating_minor_optimization"]
        for state, released, initializations in cases:
            with self.subTest(tag=state["tag"], ai=state["is_ai"], war=state["has_war"], optimized=state["locked"]):
                was_optimized = state["locked"]
                self.execute(reconcile, state)
                self.assertEqual(state["slots"], RESTORE_SLOTS[state["tag"]] if released else 0)
                self.assertEqual(state["locked"], was_optimized and not released)
                self.assertEqual(state["idea"], was_optimized and not released)
                self.assertEqual(state["initializations"], initializations)
                self.assertEqual(state["flags"].get("ADISCORD_non_participating_minor_released", False), released)
                snapshot = repr(state)
                self.execute(reconcile, state)
                self.assertEqual(repr(state), snapshot)

    def test_apply_is_once_only_and_excludes_players_and_retired_ain(self):
        apply = self.definitions["ADISCORD_apply_non_participating_minor_optimization"]
        for state in (self.state(optimized=False), self.state(ai=False, optimized=False), self.state(tag="AIN", optimized=False)):
            self.execute(apply, state)
            expected = state["is_ai"] and state["tag"] in EXPECTED_SLOTS
            self.assertEqual(state["locked"], expected)
            self.assertEqual(state["idea"], expected)
            state["slots"] = 5
            self.execute(apply, state)
            self.assertEqual(state["slots"], 5)
        for flag in ("ADISCORD_minor_optimization_fresh_campaign_v1", "ADISCORD_non_participating_minor_released"):
            state = self.state(optimized=False)
            state["flags"][flag] = flag.endswith("released")
            self.execute(apply, state)
            self.assertFalse(state["locked"])

    def test_each_tag_restores_its_own_capacity(self):
        self.assertNotIn("AIN", EXPECTED_SLOTS)
        self.assertEqual(research_restore_slots(self.effects), RESTORE_SLOTS)
        for tag, slots in RESTORE_SLOTS.items():
            with self.subTest(tag=tag):
                state = self.state(tag=tag)
                self.execute(self.definitions["ADISCORD_restore_non_participating_minor_research_slots"], state)
                self.assertEqual(state["slots"], slots)
        wrong = self.effects.replace("set_research_slots = 2", "set_research_slots = 3", 1)
        self.assertNotEqual(research_restore_slots(wrong), RESTORE_SLOTS)
        duplicate = self.effects.replace("tag = AUR", "tag = AIN", 1)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            research_restore_slots(duplicate)
        malformed = self.effects.replace("limit = { tag = AIN }", "limit = 1", 1)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            research_restore_slots(malformed)

    def test_lifecycle_validator_rejects_guard_and_order_regressions(self):
        self.assertEqual(minor_lifecycle_issues(self.triggers, self.effects, self.hooks, self.shared), [])
        mutations = (
            (self.triggers.replace("is_ai = no", "is_ai = yes", 1), self.effects, self.hooks, self.shared),
            (self.triggers.replace("NOT = { has_country_flag = ADISCORD_non_participating_minor_optimized }", "", 1), self.effects, self.hooks, self.shared),
            (self.triggers, self.effects.replace("clr_country_flag = ADISCORD_non_participating_minor_optimized", "set_country_flag = ADISCORD_non_participating_minor_optimized", 1), self.hooks, self.shared),
            (self.triggers, self.effects, self.hooks.replace("ADISCORD_economy_ai_assistance_needs_edge_evaluation = yes", "always = yes", 1), self.shared),
            (self.triggers, self.effects, self.hooks, self.shared.replace("limit = { has_country_flag = ADISCORD_non_participating_minor_optimized }", "limit = { ADISCORD_economy_has_current_schema = yes }", 1)),
        )
        for index, args in enumerate(mutations):
            with self.subTest(mutation=index):
                self.assertTrue(minor_lifecycle_issues(*args))

    def test_inventory_distinguishes_registration_land_and_passive_dependencies(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            sources = {
                "common/country_tags/tags.txt": 'AIN = "countries/AIN.txt"\nD01 = "countries/Dynamic.txt"\ndynamic_tags = yes',
                "history/states/1.txt": 'state = { history = { owner = AIN add_core_of = AIN 2161.1.1 = { owner = D01 } } }',

                "events/test.txt": 'event = { log = "# marker" AIN = { exists = yes } } # D01',
            }

            self.assertEqual(rows["AIN"]["initial_cores"], 1)
            self.assertEqual(rows["AIN"]["initial_oob"], ["AIN"])
            self.assertIn("common/ideas/passive.txt", rows["AIN"]["script_references"])
            self.assertEqual(rows["D01"]["initial_states"], 0)
8490 EconomyScriptFixture
class EconomyScriptFixture:
    """Execute the arithmetic/scope subset; unknown engine operations fail closed.

    Native engine inputs and deliberately isolated callees must be supplied by
    the test. This fixture proves script data flow, not Clausewitz loading/UI.
    """

    def __init__(self, countries=None, facts=None, stubs=()):
        self.scopes = countries if countries is not None else {"A": {}}
        self.facts = facts or {}
        self.stubs = set(stubs)
        self.calls = []
        self.definitions = {
            node.key: node.value
            for text in (EFFECTS, TRIGGERS)
            for node in parse_clausewitz(text)
        }

    def number(self, value, scope, previous):
        try:
            return float(value)
        except ValueError:
            if value.startswith("PREV."):
                return self.scopes[previous].get(value[5:], 0)
            return self.scopes[scope].get(value, 0)

    def condition(self, entries, scope="A", previous=None, root="A"):
        def one(node):
            key, value = node.key, node.value
            if key in ("AND", "OR", "NOT"):
                results = [one(child) for child in value]
                return any(results) if key == "OR" else (not any(results) if key == "NOT" else all(results))
            if key in self.facts:
                return bool(self.facts[key]) if isinstance(value, list) else self.facts[key] == (value == "yes")
            if key == "always":
                return value == "yes"
            if key == "has_variable":
                return value in self.scopes[scope]
            if key == "is_controlled_by":
                target = previous if value == "PREV" else root if value == "ROOT" else value
                return self.scopes[scope]["controller"] == target
            if key in ("check_variable", "non_damaged_building_level"):
                fields = {child.key: child.value for child in value if child.key}
                if "var" in fields:
                    left = self.number(fields["var"], scope, previous)
                    right = self.number(fields["value"], scope, previous)
                    operator = fields.get("compare", "greater_than_or_equals")
                else:
                    left_name, operator, right_value = [child.value for child in value if not child.key]
                    if key == "non_damaged_building_level":
                        assert left_name == "level"
                        left_name = "non_damaged@" + fields["building"]
                    left = self.number(left_name, scope, previous)
                    right = self.number(right_value, scope, previous)
                return {
                    "equals": left == right, "not_equals": left != right,
                    "greater_than": left > right, "less_than": left < right,
                    "greater_than_or_equals": left >= right,
                    "less_than_or_equals": left <= right,
                    ">": left > right, "<": left < right,
                }[operator]
            if key in self.definitions and value in ("yes", "no"):
                return self.condition(self.definitions[key], scope, previous, root) == (value == "yes")
            raise AssertionError(f"unsupported fixture trigger {key} = {value}")
        return all(one(node) for node in entries)

    def run(self, name, scope="A", previous=None, root="A"):
        self.calls.append(name)
        if name not in self.stubs:
            self.execute(self.definitions[name], scope, previous, root)

    def execute(self, entries, scope, previous, root):
        branch_taken = False
        for node in entries:
            key, value = node.key, node.value
            if key in ("if", "else_if", "else"):
                if key == "if":
                    branch_taken = False
                limit = next((child.value for child in value if child.key == "limit"), [])
                if not branch_taken and self.condition(limit, scope, previous, root):
                    self.execute([child for child in value if child.key != "limit"], scope, previous, root)
                    branch_taken = True
            elif key in ("ROOT", "PREV"):
                self.execute(value, root if key == "ROOT" else previous, scope, root)
            elif key == "every_owned_state":
                for state in self.scopes[scope].get("states", []):
                    self.execute(value, state, scope, root)
            elif key in ("set_country_flag", "clr_country_flag"):
                self.scopes[scope][value] = key == "set_country_flag"
            elif key.endswith("_variable"):
                fields = {child.key: child.value for child in value}
                target = fields.get("var", next(iter(fields)))
                current = self.scopes[scope].get(target, 0)
                if key.startswith("clamp_"):
                    result = min(max(current, float(fields["min"])), float(fields["max"]))
                else:
                    amount = self.number(fields.get("value", fields.get(target)), scope, previous)
                    if key.startswith("set_"):
                        result = amount
                    elif key.startswith("add_to_"):
                        result = current + amount
                    elif key.startswith("subtract_from_"):
                        result = current - amount
                    elif key.startswith("multiply_"):
                        result = current * amount
                    elif key.startswith("divide_"):
                        result = current / amount
                    else:
                        raise AssertionError(f"unsupported variable operation {key}")
                self.scopes[scope][target] = result
            elif key in self.stubs:
                self.calls.append(key)
            elif key in self.definitions and value == "yes":
                self.run(key, scope, previous, root)
            else:
                raise AssertionError(f"unsupported fixture effect {key} = {value}")

class EconomyAccountingRegressionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    PREFIX = "ADISCORD_economy_"

    def test_flat_weekly_income_is_in_cash_ai_balance_and_both_debt_denominators(self):
        fixture = EconomyScriptFixture(stubs=(
            self.PREFIX + "calculate_creditworthiness", self.PREFIX + "calculate_interest_rate",
            self.PREFIX + "calculate_debt_service_amount", self.PREFIX + "update_debt_crisis_level",
        ))
        values = fixture.scopes["A"]
        for key, value in {"monthly_income": 13, "monthly_expenses": 26,
                           "final_weekly_income_bonus": 20, "debt": 1196,
                           "debt_service": 1.3, "treasury": 100}.items():
            values[self.PREFIX + key] = value
        for effect in ("calculate_debt_metrics", "calculate_monthly_balance", "calculate_weekly_budget"):
            fixture.run(self.PREFIX + effect)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(values[self.PREFIX + "debt_income_ratio"], 100)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(values[self.PREFIX + "interest_share_income"], 0.3 / 23 * 100)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(values[self.PREFIX + "weekly_balance"], 17)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(values[self.PREFIX + "monthly_balance"] * 3 / 13, 17)
        # The annual denominator includes 52 bonuses, never twelve bonuses.
        self.assertAlmostEqual(values[self.PREFIX + "debt_income_denominator_temp"], 1196)

    def test_tier_changes_preserve_52_weekly_cash_settlements(self):
        for tiers in ([1] * 48 + [2] * 4, [2] * 48 + [1] * 4, [2] * 52):
            fixture = EconomyScriptFixture(
                facts={self.PREFIX + "is_player_tier_country": False},
                stubs=(self.PREFIX + "update_debt_state_after_settlement", self.PREFIX + "queue_debt_notification"),
            )
            values = fixture.scopes["A"]
            for key, value in {"initialized": 1, "weekly_source_cache_ready": 1, "schema_version": 15,
                               "treasury": 100, "treasury_cap": 5000, "accounting_period_treasury_start": 100,
                               "weekly_income": 7, "weekly_expenses": 2, "weekly_balance": 5}.items():
                values[self.PREFIX + key] = value
            for tier in tiers:
                values[self.PREFIX + "simulation_tier"] = tier
                gate = fixture.definitions[self.PREFIX + "should_weekly_update"]
                self.assertTrue(fixture.condition(gate))
                fixture.run(self.PREFIX + "apply_weekly_balance")
                self.assertAlmostEqual(values[self.PREFIX + "last_period_unexplained_delta"], 0)
            self.assertEqual(values[self.PREFIX + "treasury"], 360)
        yearly_graph = reachable_script_blocks((EFFECTS, MODIFIER_EFFECTS, TRIGGERS),
                                               (self.PREFIX + "yearly_update",))
        self.assertNotIn(self.PREFIX + "apply_weekly_balance", yearly_graph)
        self.assertNotIn(self.PREFIX + "apply_monthly_balance", yearly_graph)

    def test_nested_recount_credits_current_owner_not_event_root(self):
        fixture = EconomyScriptFixture(
            countries={"A": {self.PREFIX + "resource_endowment": 9}, "B": {"states": ["state"]},
                       "state": {"controller": "B", "resource@oil": 30, "building_level@arms_factory": 10,
                                 "non_damaged@ADISCORD_business_center": 2,
                                 "non_damaged@ADISCORD_science_center": 1,
                                 "non_damaged@ADISCORD_industrial_cluster": 2}},
            facts={"has_dynamic_modifier": False},
            stubs=("add_dynamic_modifier", "remove_dynamic_modifier", "force_update_dynamic_modifier"),
        )
        fixture.run(self.PREFIX + "recount_economic_buildings", scope="B", previous="A")
        owner = fixture.scopes["B"]
        self.assertEqual(fixture.scopes["A"], {self.PREFIX + "resource_endowment": 9})
        self.assertEqual(owner[self.PREFIX + "resource_endowment"], 3)
        self.assertEqual(owner["ADISCORD_business_center_count"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(owner["ADISCORD_science_center_count"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(owner[self.PREFIX + "cluster_factory_output_percent"], 10)
        self.assertIn("add_dynamic_modifier", fixture.calls)
        fixture.facts["has_dynamic_modifier"] = True
        fixture.scopes["state"]["controller"] = "A"
        fixture.run(self.PREFIX + "recount_economic_buildings", scope="B", previous="A")
        self.assertEqual(owner["ADISCORD_business_center_count"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(owner[self.PREFIX + "cluster_factory_output_percent"], 0)
        self.assertIn("remove_dynamic_modifier", fixture.calls)

    def test_cash_ledger_covers_auto_borrowing_cap_and_interweek_payment(self):
        cases = (
            # start, cash, balance, paid, borrowing, final cash, writeoff, inflation
            (3, 3, -10, 0, 7, 0, 0, 0),
            (3, 3, -10, 0, 7, 0, 0, 100),
            (490, 490, 20, 0, 0, 500, 10, 0),
            (100, 50, 5, 50, 0, 55, 0, 0),
        )
        for start, cash, balance, payment, borrowing, final, writeoff, inflation in cases:
            fixture = EconomyScriptFixture(stubs=tuple(self.PREFIX + key for key in (
                "calculate_debt_metrics", "update_macro_confidence", "update_debt_state_after_settlement",
                "queue_debt_notification")))
            values = fixture.scopes["A"]
            for key, value in {"treasury": cash, "treasury_cap": 500, "debt": 20,
                               "inflation": inflation,
                               "weekly_balance": balance, "accounting_period_treasury_start": start,
                               "current_month_action_costs": payment}.items():
                values[self.PREFIX + key] = value
            fixture.run(self.PREFIX + "apply_weekly_balance")
            self.assertEqual(values[self.PREFIX + "treasury"], final)
            self.assertEqual(values[self.PREFIX + "debt"], 20 + borrowing)
            self.assertAlmostEqual(values[self.PREFIX + "inflation"], min(100, inflation + borrowing / 100))
            self.assertEqual(values[self.PREFIX + "last_period_cap_writeoff"], writeoff)
            self.assertEqual(values[self.PREFIX + "last_period_unexplained_delta"], 0)

    def test_macro_cadence_changes_pressure_without_advancing_cash_or_debt_streaks(self):
        for scale in (1, 6):
            for balance in (-10, 10):
                fixture = EconomyScriptFixture()
                values = fixture.scopes["A"]
                for key, value in {"tick_scale": scale, "monthly_balance": balance,
                                   "deficit_pressure": 20, "final_deficit_pressure_factor_bp": 150,
                                   "treasury": 100, "debt_emergency_streak": 2}.items():
                    values[self.PREFIX + key] = value
                fixture.run(self.PREFIX + "update_monthly_budget_trend")
                self.assertEqual(values[self.PREFIX + "deficit_pressure"],
                                 20 + (1.5 * scale if balance < 0 else -2 * scale))
                self.assertEqual(values[self.PREFIX + "treasury"], 100)
                self.assertEqual(values[self.PREFIX + "debt_emergency_streak"], 2)

    def test_lower_reserve_cap_is_written_off_only_in_the_cash_ledger(self):

    def test_financing_relief_never_creates_negative_pressures(self):
        for effect, gates, treasury in (
            ("repay_debt", {"has_treasury_50": True, "has_debt": True}, 50),
            ("stabilization_package", {"can_stabilize_macro": True}, 100),
            ("stabilization_package", {"can_stabilize_macro": False, "can_stabilize_macro_crisis": True}, 0),
        ):
            fixture = EconomyScriptFixture(
                facts={self.PREFIX + key: value for key, value in gates.items()},
                stubs=tuple(self.PREFIX + key for key in ("initialize_country", "calculate_debt_metrics",
                    "calculate_macro_indicators", "reconcile_debt_state_after_action", "update_macro_confidence", "mark_dirty")),
            )
            values = fixture.scopes["A"]
            values.update({self.PREFIX + "treasury": treasury, self.PREFIX + "debt": 50,
                           self.PREFIX + "inflation": 15})
            fixture.run(self.PREFIX + effect)
            self.assertEqual(values[self.PREFIX + "fiscal_stress"], 0)
            for key in ("deficit_pressure", "price_shock", "action_overload_residue"):
                self.assertGreaterEqual(values[self.PREFIX + key], 0)
            self.assertEqual(values[self.PREFIX + "treasury"], 0)
            self.assertLess(fixture.calls.index(self.PREFIX + "clamp_financing_pressures"),
                            min(i for i, name in enumerate(fixture.calls) if name in (
                                self.PREFIX + "calculate_macro_indicators", self.PREFIX + "calculate_debt_metrics")))

    def test_preview_refresh_is_only_for_open_human_dashboard(self):
        for human, opened in ((False, False), (False, True), (True, False), (True, True)):
            fixture = EconomyScriptFixture(
                facts={self.PREFIX + "should_show_player_ui": human, self.PREFIX + "window_is_open": opened},
                stubs=(self.PREFIX + "refresh_policy_previews",),
            )
            fixture.run(self.PREFIX + "refresh_open_window")
            self.assertEqual(self.PREFIX + "refresh_policy_previews" in fixture.calls, human and opened)
        weekly_hook = block(ON_ACTIONS, "on_weekly")
        self.assertLess(weekly_hook.index(self.PREFIX + "weekly_update = yes"),
                        weekly_hook.index(self.PREFIX + "refresh_open_window = yes"))
        for name in ("monthly_update", "yearly_update"):
            pulse = block(EFFECTS, self.PREFIX + name)
            self.assertLess(pulse.rindex(self.PREFIX + "clamp_all_variables"),
                            pulse.rindex(self.PREFIX + "light_update"))
            self.assertLess(pulse.rindex(self.PREFIX + "light_update"),
                            pulse.rindex(self.PREFIX + "refresh_policy_previews"))

    def test_war_relations_and_monthly_reconciliation_cover_both_participants(self):

        self.assertIn("FROM = {", relation)

                        monthly.index(self.PREFIX + "should_monthly_update"))

        effect = next(node for node in peace.value if node.key == "effect")
        first_branch = effect.value[0]

        self.assertEqual([(node.key, node.value) for node in limit.value],
                         [(self.PREFIX + "has_current_schema", "yes")])

ADISCORD_economy_apply_development_income_multipliers = {
	set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_income_multiplier value = 100 }

SOURCE common/scripted_effects/ADISCORD_economy_effects.txt ADISCORD_economy_light_update LINE 779
ADISCORD_economy_light_update = {
	# Cheap TDA-style forecast/update. Idea-backed economic model and policy
	# factors are cached by monthly/yearly refreshes and by opening the window;
	# the weekly cash pulse must not query every law again.
	ADISCORD_economy_calculate_income = yes
	ADISCORD_economy_calculate_macro_indicators = yes
	ADISCORD_economy_calculate_expenses = yes
	ADISCORD_economy_calculate_monthly_balance = yes
	# Every caller, including budget buttons and treasury actions, must refresh
	# the weekly KPI immediately instead of leaving it stale until the next pulse.
	ADISCORD_economy_calculate_weekly_budget = yes
	# Kept inline: a newly named scripted effect is not registered reliably by
	# HOI4's hot reload, while these four cached-variable checks are cheap.
	set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_cycle_phase value = 1 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_monthly_balance value = 0 compare = less_than } } set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_cycle_phase value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_monthly_balance value = 5 compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_stretched_level value = 2 compare = less_than } } set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_cycle_phase value = 2 } }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_inflation value = 30 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_stretched_level value = 3 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_debt_crisis_level value = 3 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_cycle_phase value = 3 }
	}
}

ADISCORD_economy_recount_economic_buildings = {
	# V24: one owned-state pass counts economic buildings and calculates the
	# location-sensitive cluster bonus. No weekly state scan is introduced.
	set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_business_center_count value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_science_center_count value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_industrial_cluster_count value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_cluster_factory_output_percent value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_cluster_factory_output_factor value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_operational_military_factories_temp value = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_cluster_supported_factory_points_temp value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_resource_endowment value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_damaged_industry_score value = 0 }

	every_owned_state = {
		# Actual state resources feed a compact strategic-endowment index. Each
		# resource type contributes one point, with extra weight for large fields.
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { resource@oil > 0 } } PREV = { add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_resource_endowment value = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { resource@oil > 9 } } PREV = { add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_resource_endowment value = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { resource@oil > 29 } } PREV = { add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_resource_endowment value = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { resource@aluminium > 0 } } PREV = { add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_resource_endowment value = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { resource@aluminium > 9 } } PREV = { add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_resource_endowment value = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { resource@rubber > 0 } } PREV = { add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_resource_endowment value = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { resource@rubber > 9 } } PREV = { add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_resource_endowment value = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { resource@tungsten > 0 } } PREV = { add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_resource_endowment value = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { resource@tungsten > 9 } } PREV = { add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_resource_endowment value = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { resource@steel > 0 } } PREV = { add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_resource_endowment value = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { resource@steel > 9 } } PREV = { add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_resource_endowment value = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { resource@steel > 29 } } PREV = { add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_resource_endowment value = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { resource@chromium > 0 } } PREV = { add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_resource_endowment value = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { resource@chromium > 9 } } PREV = { add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_resource_endowment value = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { resource@coal > 0 } } PREV = { add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_resource_endowment value = 0.5 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { resource@coal > 19 } } PREV = { add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_resource_endowment value = 0.5 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { resource@rare_components > 0 } } PREV = { add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_resource_endowment value = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { resource@rare_components > 7 } } PREV = { add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_resource_endowment value = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { resource@rare_alloys > 0 } } PREV = { add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_resource_endowment value = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { resource@rare_alloys > 7 } } PREV = { add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_resource_endowment value = 1 } } }

		set_temp_variable = { ADISCORD_economy_state_damage_temp = damaged_building_level@infrastructure }
		add_to_temp_variable = { ADISCORD_economy_state_damage_temp = damaged_building_level@arms_factory }
		add_to_temp_variable = { ADISCORD_economy_state_damage_temp = damaged_building_level@industrial_complex }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_state_damage_temp value = 0 compare = greater_than } } PREV = { add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_damaged_industry_score value = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_state_damage_temp value = 2 compare = greater_than } } PREV = { add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_damaged_industry_score value = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_state_damage_temp value = 5 compare = greater_than } } PREV = { add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_damaged_industry_score value = 1 } } }

		# HOI4 has no state-scoped factory-output modifier. Count operational
		# military factories here so the country modifier can reproduce the exact
		# weighted effect of +5% per cluster level in this particular state.
		set_temp_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_state_operational_mils_temp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { is_controlled_by = PREV }
			set_temp_variable = { ADISCORD_economy_state_operational_mils_temp = building_level@arms_factory }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { ADISCORD_economy_state_operational_mils_temp = damaged_building_level@arms_factory }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_state_operational_mils_temp min = 0 max = 100 }
			PREV = {
				add_to_temp_variable = {
					var = ADISCORD_economy_operational_military_factories_temp
					value = PREV.ADISCORD_economy_state_operational_mils_temp
				}
			}
		}

		# Occupied owned states must not keep funding the displaced owner or its
		# national science/industry network. One enclosing control check is cheaper
		# than repeating it for every building level below.
		if = {
			limit = { is_controlled_by = PREV }

		# Threshold checks mirror building state_max caps. Update these checks if the caps change.
		if = {
			limit = {
				non_damaged_building_level = {
					building = ADISCORD_business_center
					level > 0
				}
			}
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_business_center_count value = 1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				non_damaged_building_level = {
					building = ADISCORD_business_center
					level > 1
				}
			}
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_business_center_count value = 1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				non_damaged_building_level = {
					building = ADISCORD_business_center
					level > 2
				}
			}
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_business_center_count value = 1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				non_damaged_building_level = {
					building = ADISCORD_science_center
					level > 0
				}
			}
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_science_center_count value = 1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				non_damaged_building_level = {
					building = ADISCORD_science_center
					level > 1
				}
			}
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_science_center_count value = 1 } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_state_cluster_level_temp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				non_damaged_building_level = {
					building = ADISCORD_industrial_cluster
					level > 0
				}
			}
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_industrial_cluster_count value = 1 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_state_cluster_level_temp value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				non_damaged_building_level = {
					building = ADISCORD_industrial_cluster
					level > 1
				}
			}
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_industrial_cluster_count value = 1 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_state_cluster_level_temp value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				non_damaged_building_level = {
					building = ADISCORD_industrial_cluster
					level > 2
				}
			}
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { var = ADISCORD_industrial_cluster_count value = 1 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_state_cluster_level_temp value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_state_cluster_level_temp value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_state_cluster_supported_mils_temp value = ADISCORD_economy_state_operational_mils_temp }
			multiply_temp_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_state_cluster_supported_mils_temp value = ADISCORD_economy_state_cluster_level_temp }
			PREV = {
				add_to_temp_variable = {
					var = ADISCORD_economy_cluster_supported_factory_points_temp
					value = PREV.ADISCORD_economy_state_cluster_supported_mils_temp
				}
			}
		}
		}
	}

	# Example: 10 operational military factories under a level-2 cluster among
	# 20 national factories become a +5% country modifier: (10 * 2 * 5) / 20.
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_operational_military_factories_temp value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
		set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_cluster_factory_output_percent value = ADISCORD_economy_cluster_supported_factory_points_temp }
		multiply_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_cluster_factory_output_percent value = 5 }
		divide_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_cluster_factory_output_percent value = ADISCORD_economy_operational_military_factories_temp }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_cluster_factory_output_percent min = 0 max = 15 }
	set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_cluster_factory_output_factor value = ADISCORD_economy_cluster_factory_output_percent }
	divide_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_cluster_factory_output_factor value = 100 }
	clamp_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_cluster_factory_output_factor min = 0 max = 0.15 }
	if = {

		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ADISCORD_economy_cluster_local_factory_output } }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ADISCORD_economy_cluster_local_factory_output }
		}
	}
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes

	clamp_variable = { var = ADISCORD_business_center_count min = 0 max = 999 }
	clamp_variable = { var = ADISCORD_science_center_count min = 0 max = 999 }
	clamp_variable = { var = ADISCORD_industrial_cluster_count min = 0 max = 999 }
	clamp_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_resource_endowment min = 0 max = 100 }
	clamp_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_damaged_industry_score min = 0 max = 100 }

}
SOURCE common/scripted_effects/ADISCORD_economy_effects.txt ADISCORD_economy_update_ai_state LINE 3707
ADISCORD_economy_update_ai_state = {
	# Hysteresis: crisis and recovery have stricter exit thresholds than entry
	# thresholds, preventing budget modes from changing direction every tick.
	if = {
		limit = { ADISCORD_economy_ai_is_crisis = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_monthly_balance value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_surplus_streak value = 2 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_debt_income_ratio value = 70 compare = less_than }
				check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_fiscal_stress value = 45 compare = less_than }
			}
			set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_ai_state value = 3 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { ADISCORD_economy_ai_is_recovery = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_debt_income_ratio value = 110 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_fiscal_stress value = 75 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_ai_state value = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_monthly_balance value = 0 compare = less_than }
					check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_deficit_streak value = 2 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_ai_state value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_surplus_streak value = 6 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_debt_income_ratio value = 35 compare = less_than }
				check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_fiscal_stress value = 20 compare = less_than }
				check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_treasury value = 75 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_ai_state value = 0 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { ADISCORD_economy_ai_is_stressed = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_debt_income_ratio value = 100 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_fiscal_stress value = 70 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_deficit_streak value = 6 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_treasury value = 10 compare = less_than }
						check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_monthly_balance value = 0 compare = less_than }
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_ai_state value = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_surplus_streak value = 3 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_debt_income_ratio value = 50 compare = less_than }
				check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_fiscal_stress value = 30 compare = less_than }
			}
			set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_ai_state value = 0 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_debt_income_ratio value = 110 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_fiscal_stress value = 75 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_deficit_streak value = 6 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_ai_state value = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_deficit_streak value = 2 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_debt_income_ratio value = 65 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_fiscal_stress value = 40 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_treasury value = 25 compare = less_than }
						check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_monthly_balance value = 0 compare = less_than }
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_ai_state value = 1 }
		}
	}
}
SOURCE common/scripted_effects/ADISCORD_VAL_effects.txt VAL_refresh_industrial_economy LINE 2080
VAL_refresh_industrial_economy = {
	set_variable = { var = VAL_industrial_output value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = VAL_industrial_construction value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = VAL_industrial_efficiency value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = VAL_industrial_trade value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = VAL_industrial_income value = 0 }
	set_variable = { var = VAL_industrial_consumer value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = VAL_vorkerland_contracts_disrupted }
		clamp_variable = { var = VAL_economic_recovery_steps min = 0 max = 6 }
		set_variable = { var = VAL_industrial_output value = VAL_economic_recovery_steps }
		multiply_variable = { var = VAL_industrial_output value = 0.13 }
		add_to_variable = { var = VAL_industrial_output value = -0.75 }
		set_variable = { var = VAL_industrial_construction value = VAL_economic_recovery_steps }
		multiply_variable = { var = VAL_industrial_construction value = 0.10 }
		add_to_variable = { var = VAL_industrial_construction value = -0.57 }
		set_variable = { var = VAL_industrial_efficiency value = VAL_economic_recovery_steps }
		multiply_variable = { var = VAL_industrial_efficiency value = 0.10 }
		add_to_variable = { var = VAL_industrial_efficiency value = -0.57 }
		set_variable = { var = VAL_industrial_trade value = VAL_economic_recovery_steps }
		multiply_variable = { var = VAL_industrial_trade value = 0.15 }
		add_to_variable = { var = VAL_industrial_trade value = -0.85 }
		set_variable = { var = VAL_industrial_income value = VAL_economic_recovery_steps }
		multiply_variable = { var = VAL_industrial_income value = 0.10 }
		add_to_variable = { var = VAL_industrial_income value = -0.57 }
		set_variable = { var = VAL_industrial_consumer value = VAL_economic_recovery_steps }
		multiply_variable = { var = VAL_industrial_consumer value = -0.03 }
		add_to_variable = { var = VAL_industrial_consumer value = 0.18 }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_variable = VAL_arsenal_investment } add_to_variable = { var = VAL_industrial_output value = VAL_arsenal_investment } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = VAL_civilian_investment } add_to_variable = { var = VAL_industrial_construction value = VAL_civilian_investment } }
	remove_ideas = VAL_vorkerland_contract_disruptions
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = VAL_vorkerland_contracts_disrupted } }
		if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = VAL_economic_collapse } remove_dynamic_modifier = VAL_economic_collapse }
		if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = VAL_economic_miracle } remove_dynamic_modifier = VAL_economic_miracle }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = VAL_contract_industry } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = VAL_contract_industry } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = VAL_economic_recovery_steps value = 6 compare = less_than } }
		if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = VAL_contract_industry } remove_dynamic_modifier = VAL_contract_industry }
		if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = VAL_economic_miracle } remove_dynamic_modifier = VAL_economic_miracle }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = VAL_economic_collapse } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = VAL_economic_collapse } }
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = VAL_contract_industry } remove_dynamic_modifier = VAL_contract_industry }
		if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = VAL_economic_collapse } remove_dynamic_modifier = VAL_economic_collapse }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = VAL_economic_miracle } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = VAL_economic_miracle } }
	}
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
	ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
}

		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = STP_pw_supply_consumption_factor } } set_variable = { var = STP_pw_supply_consumption_factor value = 0 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = STP_pw_training_time_factor } } set_variable = { var = STP_pw_training_time_factor value = 0 } }
		if = { limit = { tag = STS NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = STP_pw_republic_dynamic } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = STP_pw_republic_dynamic } }
		if = { limit = { tag = STP NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = STP_pw_party_dynamic } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = STP_pw_party_dynamic } }
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
		ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes
	}

 option = {
  name = VAL_export_decline
  ai_chance = { base = 10 }
  hidden_effect = { if = { limit = { has_country_flag = VAL_export_offer_arms } clr_country_flag = VAL_export_offer_arms VAL = { clr_country_flag = VAL_export_offer_pending } } }
 }
 option = {
  name = VAL_export_accept
  trigger = { VAL_export_arms_can_accept = yes }
  ai_chance = { base = 90 }
  custom_effect_tooltip = VAL_export_arms_accepted_tt
  hidden_effect = {
   if = {
    limit = { VAL_export_arms_can_accept = yes }
    ADISCORD_economy_spend_100 = yes
    VAL = {
     send_equipment = { equipment = infantry_equipment amount = 2500 target = ROOT }
     if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = VAL_export_income_1 } } add_timed_idea = { idea = VAL_export_income_1 days = 70 } }
     else = { add_timed_idea = { idea = VAL_export_income_2 days = 70 } }
    }
    clr_country_flag = VAL_export_offer_arms
    set_country_flag = { flag = VAL_export_customer_cooldown days = 70 }
    VAL = { clr_country_flag = VAL_export_offer_pending }
   }
  }
 }
}
